findings.title: post.mjs --add is not idempotent: a re-run duplicates the agent's findings
steps: .claude/scripts/pr-test/post.mjs:125 `writeFileSync(file, JSON.stringify(report, null, 2));` writes the merged findings back into report.json
A failed status call exits 1 (FR-010), so the caller retries the same `post.mjs --report <out>/report.json --add <out>/agent-findings.json`
The retry folds agent-findings.json in a second time: every agent finding appears twice in the review, the summary count and the PR description

findings.title: Any HTTP 422 on the review call is treated as the own-PR refusal
steps: .claude/scripts/pr-test/post.mjs:49 `const ownPrRefusal = (stderr) => /own pull request|HTTP 422/i.test(stderr);`
A 422 for another reason (for example a commit_id no longer on the PR after a push) silently falls back to a COMMENT review instead of surfacing the error

findings.title: Merge gate does not see the GraphQL merge mutation
steps: .claude/hooks/merge-gate.mjs:34 only matches `gh pr merge` and REST `repos/<o>/<r>/pulls/<n>/merge`
`gh api graphql` with a mergePullRequest mutation merges without an agent-review success; FR-011 names only the gh and REST paths, so this is hardening, not a requirement miss

findings.title: Teardown removes the run directory twice
steps: run.log ends with `teardown: remove .../mf-prtest-21-ZFV3BT` twice; .claude/scripts/pr-test/run.mjs:129 registers the removal and another path registers the same one
Harmless (force: true) but the teardown log no longer maps one line to one resource
